text:
marcus: Quick final gate for marketplace listing tomorrow 17:00 UTC. Need: partner logo clearance, SKU visibility for Dedicated, SI test toggle, and press embargo window. Notion: https://notion.redwood/marketplace/gate

anna: I have logos in s3://marketplace/assets/logos and added alt text. Waiting on legal signoff for partner attribution line.

kevin-hw: Logos cleared, firmware note added: fw>=5.2 required for dedicated. SKU visibility set to hidden if firmware not present.

emma-ops: Ops will confirm firmware pool by 15:00 UTC. Promo codes seeded: PARTNER20 x300.

legal-bot: Legal check: remove comparative claim in tagline, add privacy link. Marked as resolved after edit.

marcus: Great. Quick checklist (react when done): logos, legal copy, ops firmware, si toggle.

anna: logos done :white_check_mark:

legal-bot: copy updated :white_check_mark:

emma-ops: firmware confirmed in GA pool :white_check_mark:

kevin-hw: SI test toggle ready; will flip if auth errors occur.

launch-bot: Preflight at T-30m and T-10m. Will block publish until pass.

marcus: If preflight passes we proceed to staged rollouts: NA canary 16:00 UTC, global GA 17:00 UTC. Embargo at GA+8m.

kevin-hw: SI harness green. No blockers.

marcus: Thanks everyone. I'll post go/no-go after T-10m smoke.
